io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo.description: Local read-only Corvint context and repository evidence server.
io.modelcontextprotocol/serverInfo.name: corvint-mcp

tools.name: corvint.flows.gaps
tools.description: Report the flows at HEAD without passing test evidence and the tests no flow names (application-flow-gaps/1).

tools.name: corvint.flows.impact
tools.description: Report the flows the base..HEAD changed paths reach through links and the impact graph (application-flow-impact/1).

tools.name: corvint.flows.map
tools.description: Map the flow intents at HEAD to their links and test evidence, or look up the flows one path or test key reaches (application-flow-map/1, application-flow-lookup/1).

tools.name: corvint.flows.navigate
tools.description: Compile the navigation map of the flow intents at HEAD, or the ordered packet that reaches one goal flow with each step above maxEffect marked requires-grant (application-navigation-map/0, application-navigation-packet/0).

tools.name: corvint.impact
tools.description: Compile revision-bound impact evidence for tracked Go files without returning source bodies.

tools.name: corvint.query
tools.description: Compile the narrow project-operations authority-start receipt (limit is fixed at one).

tools.name: corvint.status
tools.description: Observe Git commit, tree, worktree state, and a privacy-preserving dirty-path digest.
